name: Glass chat thread
oneLiner: a message thread floats in 3D with no phone: typing dots, then the reply lands; bubbles arrive left and right on springs and push the thread up, a read receipt ticks in and a heart reaction lands on the last bubble with a burst
say: when the speaker retells a conversation ('so I texted her...', 'a customer messaged me'): one bubble per line they say, the heart lands on the punchline
